# Homebuilding & Renovating

> The UK's leading resource for homebuilding, self-build, renovation advice, and sustainable housing solutions.

Homebuilding & Renovating provides expert guidance on DIY home improvements, building regulations, renewable energy, and sustainable housing across the UK. The site combines practical how-to guides, industry news, product buying advice, and a comprehensive suppliers directory to support homeowners and self-builders.

## Key Topics

- Home renovation
- Self-build housing
- DIY home improvement
- Renewable energy
- Solar panels
- Insulation
- Sustainable housing
- Building regulations
- Home maintenance
- Eco homes
- Heating systems
- Magazine subscription
- Suppliers directory
- Home safety
- Garden design

## Essential Guides & How-To

- [Advice | Homebuilding](https://www.homebuilding.co.uk/advice): Hub for home building advice covering DIY tips, renovation, insulation, flooring, heating
- [How To | Homebuilding](https://www.homebuilding.co.uk/how-to): How-to guides for DIY home improvements, maintenance, and outdoor care projects
- [Buying Guide | Homebuilding](https://www.homebuilding.co.uk/buying-guides): Product buying guides and comparisons for home improvement tools and appliances
- [How to stop pests in insulation: 5-step guide](https://www.homebuilding.co.uk/heating/insulation/how-to-stop-pests-in-insulation): Five-step pest control guide for insulation including rodent prevention techniques
- [How to paint stripes on a wall](https://www.homebuilding.co.uk/advice/how-to-paint-stripes-on-a-wall): Step-by-step DIY guide for painting wall stripes with techniques and tools needed
- [Why you should never use your tumble dryer at night](https://www.homebuilding.co.uk/rooms/utility/risks-of-using-a-tumble-dryer-at-night): Expert guide on tumble dryer fire risks and home safety prevention measures

## News & Industry Coverage

- [News | Homebuilding](https://www.homebuilding.co.uk/news): Latest homebuilding industry news including renewable energy and building regulations
- [Eco Homes Coverage | Homebuilding](https://www.homebuilding.co.uk/eco-homes): Coverage of eco homes, renewable energy, solar panels, and sustainable housing in UK
- [Plug-in solar panels to be legalised in the UK](https://www.homebuilding.co.uk/eco-homes/solar-panels/plug-in-solar-panels-to-be-legalised-for-the-first-time-in-the-uk-despite-safety-concerns): UK plug-in solar panel legalization news covering energy policy and renewable options
- [Insurance Coverage | Homebuilding](https://www.homebuilding.co.uk/insurance): Home and self-build insurance coverage, indemnity insurance, and structural warranties
- [Garden Coverage | Homebuilding](https://www.homebuilding.co.uk/outdoors/garden): Garden guides, lawn care, design, and gardening tips from experts like Monty Don

## Sustainability & Regulations

- [The items you can recycle after the March 2026 rule change](https://www.homebuilding.co.uk/renovation/what-can-go-in-your-recycling-bin-after-the-rules-change-in-2026): Guide to acceptable items under England's new Simpler Recycling scheme from March 2026
- [These common items can't go in recycling bins from 31 March](https://www.homebuilding.co.uk/renovation/items-you-can-no-longer-recycle-under-governments-simpler-recycling-scheme): Guide to new England recycling rules and items no longer accepted from March 2026
